perRecipientRecordSerialization.repair: The fixed-capacity body store retains canonical 43-byte record bodies. Recipient-specific 120/129 headers are written independently and immutable record bytes are copied into the selected canonical representation.

telemetryOffSlabWork.repair: Outstanding-delivery slab copies and clears now execute only while telemetry is Detailed. Removing the production guard was mutation-tested and failed the regression.
